title: Bat dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- moon glow -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='18' r='12' fill='#f4e6a1'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='15' r='3' fill='#fff3bb'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='21' r='2' fill='#fff3bb'/>
  <!-- left wing raised -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q20 26 8 34 Q14 40 12 48 Q20 52 24 46 Q26 56 34 54 Q36 60 42 54 Z' fill='#8a5cd8'/>
  <path d='M40 47 Q24 32 14 38 Q20 43 20 49 Q27 51 30 46 Q33 55 39 53 Z' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <!-- right wing lowered -->
  <path d='M58 52 Q78 62 90 56 Q84 68 86 76 Q76 74 72 66 Q68 58 58 58 Z' fill='#8a5cd8'/>
  <path d='M60 54 Q76 64 84 60 Q80 68 81 73 Q73 70 70 64 Q67 58 60 58 Z' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#5e3a9e'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#a37ce8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='12' fill='#5e3a9e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M40 30 L37 18 L46 26 Z' fill='#5e3a9e'/>
  <path d='M60 30 L63 18 L54 26 Z' fill='#5e3a9e'/>
  <path d='M41 28 L39 21 L45 26 Z' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <path d='M59 28 L61 21 L55 26 Z' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#f4e6a1'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#f4e6a1'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='36.2' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='36.2' r='1' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c8a8f8'/>
  <circle cx='48.4' cy='42.6' r='0.8' fill='#3a2060'/>
  <circle cx='51.6' cy='42.6' r='0.8' fill='#3a2060'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M47 45 Q50 48 53 45' stroke='#3a2060' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M44 72 Q42 80 38 82' stroke='#5e3a9e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 72 Q58 80 63 81' stroke='#5e3a9e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='83' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='82' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#b58cf0'/>
  <!-- little music notes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='20' r='2.4' fill='#f4e6a1'/>
  <path d='M26 20 L26 13 Q29 14 30 16' stroke='#f4e6a1' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='28' r='2' fill='#f4e6a1'/>
  <path d='M72 28 L72 22 Q74.5 23 75.5 24.8' stroke='#f4e6a1' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
